steps.narration: In this walkthrough you will build a complete business requirements document by talking it through with Velox. Start at the sign-in screen.

beats.caption: Build a BRD by conversation

steps.narration: Sign in with Microsoft, using the same Azure AD account you already use at Deluxe.

beats.caption: Sign in with Azure AD

steps.narration: You land in the Velox workspace, with every module listed down the left rail.

beats.caption: Modules are listed in the left rail

steps.narration: Before you draft anything, pick the project you are working in from the top right.

beats.caption: Open the project picker

steps.narration: The Project Workspace panel lists the projects you already have.

beats.caption: See your existing projects

steps.narration: To start a new one, name it, choose a BRD template, and link your Jira project and Confluence space.

beats.caption: Name it, choose a template, link Atlassian

steps.narration: Or select a project you already have and continue.

beats.caption: ..or pick an existing project

steps.narration: The project name now sits in the header. Open the BRD Assistant from the left rail.

beats.caption: Open the BRD Assistant

steps.narration: Every BRD lives inside a session. Start a new one here.

beats.caption: Start a new session

steps.narration: Choose whether the session carries your project's accumulated context, or starts completely fresh.

beats.caption: Carry context or start fresh

steps.narration: There are two ways to begin. This walkthrough takes the conversation route rather than uploading documents.

beats.caption: Start with a conversation

steps.narration: Mary is the Strategic Business Analyst inside Velox. The panel on the right lists the sixteen sections she will draft.

beats.caption: Mary drafts the sixteen BRD sections

steps.narration: Open the conversation with whatever you know. A single sentence about the project is enough to begin.

beats.caption: Open with what you already know

steps.narration: The Generate BRD button is live from the start. Nothing is drafted until you press it.

beats.caption: Nothing drafts until you press the generate BRD button

steps.narration: Mary works through the gaps, asking for the detail she needs to fill each section.

beats.caption: Mary asks for the detail she needs

steps.narration: Answer in your own words. Here, I'll describe a chargeback and dispute automation request.

beats.caption: Describe your request in plain words

steps.narration: She keeps building context, one question at a time, in whatever order the conversation takes.

beats.caption: Mary builds context question by question

steps.narration: Answer as you would in a discovery call, with whatever detail you actually have.

beats.caption: Answer as you would in a call

steps.narration: Where one answer covers two separate issues, Mary treats each on its own.

beats.caption: Separate issues stay separate

steps.narration: Describe the process end to end, including the people and the systems involved.

beats.caption: Describe the process end to end

steps.narration: Mary plays her understanding back to you, so you can correct it before anything is written.

beats.caption: Correct her understanding early

steps.narration: When something matters, Mary saves it as a fact and shows you exactly what she recorded.

beats.caption: Facts are recorded as you talk

steps.narration: Keep going for as long as it is useful, covering scope, constraints and edge cases.

beats.caption: Cover scope, constraints and edge cases

steps.narration: Every fact she keeps is visible, so nothing is inferred behind your back.

beats.caption: Every saved fact is visible

steps.narration: There is no threshold to clear. Press Generate BRD whenever the detail feels sufficient.

beats.caption: Generate whenever you are ready

steps.narration: Velox reads the conversation, builds context, and drafts each section in turn.

beats.caption: Velox drafts each section in turn

steps.narration: A few moments later the full sixteen-section Deluxe BRD is drafted and on screen.

beats.caption: Sixteen sections drafted

steps.narration: Edit any section inline, or keep talking to Mary and refine it in the chat.

beats.caption: Edit inline or refine by chat

steps.narration: When it is ready, download it as a Word document, or push it straight to Confluence.

beats.caption: Download or send to Confluence

steps.narration: The same BRD you would have written. Written with you, when you decide, in a fraction of the time.

beats.caption: Written with you, not for you
